notes.title: Watchman at the festival: Steam Next Fest.
notes.content:
[h3][b]In October, a festival starts in the Steam store: Steam Next Fest.
The game will participate in this festival: Watchman.[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=8lUtjNdsszU;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Especially for this event, another fairly important demo update was released, which you can check out now!
[*] What's New: Many distractions fixed, level reworked after the night shift, hard difficulty tweaked (with new gameplay mechanics) and a bunch of other cool stuff.
[*] Thanks to the update, the demo turned out to be perfectly balanced in terms of gameplay and storytelling.
[*] I hope I don't have to update the demo again)
[/list]

tags.balance_change: hard difficulty tweaked (with new gameplay mechanics)

notes.title: NEW DEMO AVAILABLE RIGHT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Immerse yourself in the depths of the subconscious now![/h1]
[h3]The new demo contains:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 1st act from the main game.
[*] Achievements.
[*] Completely redesigned game concept.
[*] New and very cunning artificial intelligence.
[*] Improved visual component of the game.
[*] Reworked very high quality main characters of the game, with facial animation.
[*] New gameplay mechanics of the game.
[*] Extended location.
[*] A new convenient CCTV camera system integrated into the TV.
[*] Redesigned main menu and pause menu with detailed settings.
[*] Full gamepad support (XBOX)
[*] And a huge number of things that are not included in this list.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=v-upIVb0mRI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Play, share your impressions about the demo wherever you like and with your friends![/h3]

[h2]Special thanks in advance to those who want to contribute to the promotion of the game by any means![/h2]
